tei:div.tei:p: 191) rtsa gsum srung mar bcas pa'i skong gso dus dang rgyun du bgatong tshul rig 'dzin rgyud pa'i zhal lung bzhugs so// 192) na mo shrī badz+ra dharma pā la ye/ srid dang zhi ba'i chu gter rab brgal nas// rnam mkhyen rin chen gling gi lam ston rje// chos kyi rgyal mtshan ngag gi dbyang phyug che// 'gro ba'i ded dpon rigs kyi bdag por 'dud// rkang gnyis gtso bo ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'dod chags dang bral skyob pa dam pa'i chos// tshogs kyi mchog gyur 'dren pa dge 'dun ste// dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyis shis pa stsol// gangs can bstan pa'i nyi ma mkhan slob chos// so zur gnubs gnyags nyang gur byang gsum dang*// dam gtsang byams gsum kun mkhyen rong klong gnyis// mnga' paṇa phreng gter 'jigs bral gling pa sogs/ bka' gter rig 'dzin rgyud pas bdag skyongs shig /rnam kun mchog ldan mi 'gyur bde chen gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin// gzhan phan karma chags thogs med pa 'jig rten dbang phyug snying rje'i bdag /kun bzang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i shes rab gcig bsdus 'jam dpal dbyangs// rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul yab sras gsum la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sde bzhi dge bcu phun tshogs dpal gyi yul// phyogs las rnam rgyal yang dag byang chub brnyes// gsang chen chos kyis 'dzam gling 193) tha gru khyab// gang gi ring lugs rdul bral 'di na'o//

de la yang dus kyi mchod pa dang*/ rgyun gyi skong gso dang*/ rjes dran gyi mchod pa'o/ dang po zla ba byung ngo cog gi dus bzang rnams su tshogs mchod dang skong bshags bgyi ba'i 'don 'grigs la/ thog mar dkar phyogs kyi tshes lnga la chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i zab gter thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i gzhung bsrangs nas rtsa gsum skong gso gtong tshul ni/ hrīḥ sngon bskal= bsang chu byin rlabs dang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ spos phyung*/ las byang pad phreng las/ spyi gtsug pad sdong= sogs kyi skyabs yul/ rnying sngon/ bla ma la skyabs= mchi'o/ na mo/ bla ma dkon mchog= thob par shog lan gsum/ kye ma= sems bskyed do/ rnying sngon/ deng bzung= puts+tsha ho/ bar/ dkar gtor bkra shis rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ bgegs gtor bdud las rnam rgyal/ bsdu na rnying sngon dkar gtor dang*/ kha 'phang bgegs gtor/ las byang gi hūm̐: nyon cig= kha 'phang*/ bgegs thams cad= song bar bsgom: las byang*/ hūm̐: nga ni= kha 'phang*/ hūm̐/ steng gi= las byang gi brda sgo nas/ bzhugs gsol rjes/ mchod 'bum/ las byang phyag 'tshal/ glu mchod/ mchod 'bum phyi nang gsang gsum= sman mchod mthar/ kha 'phang khā hi sbyar/ rak+ta gtor ma gsum nas bzung bstod pa'i mgo bar las byang ltar/ bstod bshags mchod 'bum ltar/ gsol 194) 'debs/ las byang*/ dzab skul/ sngags mchod tshar gsum/ dzab dgongs gnad gzer ltar/ dregs pa tshar gcod= yan rim bzhin/ mchod bstod/ dngos grub/ dge bsngo sogs bya/ gnam chos phur mjug nas/ seng gdong yan/ ma mgon lcam dral dbu nas/ skong ba tshar nyer lnga/ 'khrugs skong*/ phud bshal/ lhun grub mdzod: bar/ legs ldan/ sde bdun 'khrugs bsal/ gnam chos ma ning*/ dngos grub 'byung gter/ mdung 'dzin/ brag lha/ jo bo zhal bzhi/ nyang gi phyag bzhi/ stong nyid spros dral/ gnod sbyin bcas/ ma mo e ka dza ṭi'i las byang*/ gnam chos dud sol nas/ dur bdag gsol ka/

'khrugs skong tshar nyer lnga/ ngan ne rgyas pa/ rta lha/ dzam la/ a par tsit+ta/ ye shes grags/ tshe ring ma/ g.yu sgron/ dur khrod lha mo/ gza'/ dam can/ tsi'u dmar/ lung btsan/ drag sgrub sprul pa/ mkha' ri/ thang lha/ spom ra nas/ klu rgyal bcas/ bla ma mchod chog kha 'phang byin 'bebs/ las byang tshogs zhus nas byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren/ mchod pa yan/ rdzogs bskang*/ gsang 'dus bskang ba/ rgyal ba spyi bskang*/ rat+na'i ma ning 'don yod na/ ma ning bskang ba/ phyag bzhi'i bskang ba/ gong du ma song na/ sde bdun mar 'gron bskang ba/ gong du ma song na/ ma mo'i gsol bskang*/ dam can gsol ka thugs dam gnad bskul/ smre bshags/ las byang bar bshags/ e 195) bskyed/ tshogs snod/ gtor 'gugs/ kha 'phang dpang gzu/ 'gugs stim/ las byang bsgral stab/ drang lhag dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud= las byang bskul/ las chas ma mo'i bskul/ khro bor rol pa'i= dam can bskul/ las byang chad brtan/ kha 'phang seng gdong zlog pa/ bro mnan/ bkra shis/ smon lam/ lhag chad kha skong*/ bdag dang 'gro la= bsdu rim/ bdag bskyed ma lus= rgyun spyod/ hrīḥbadag nyid= rjes su/ dus dang rnam pa= dang*/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= sogs kyis tshes lnga'i dus mchod grub/ ༈ dkar phyogs kyi tshes brgyad la snga 'gyur bka' gter zung 'jug khams byon mgon po tshogs kyi bdag po'i gsol mchod gtong dgos pas/ hrīḥ sngon bskal= dug phyung*/ khrus/ dngos grub 'byung gter ltar/ spos phyung*/ rat+na'i gur drag he pa'i lhan thabs las/ skyabs sems yan bdun/ bgegs gtor/ las byang bka' bsgo nas/ bstod bshags/ sngags mchod gsum/ gsol 'debs/ dzab skul/ lhan thabs ltar/ srung ba las bzhi'i gsham 'dogs/ mchod bstod/ dge bsngo/ gnam chos gur drag gsang sgrub nas/ seng gdong yan/ ma mgon lcam dral/ skong ba nyer lnga/ legs ldan/ rat+na'i ma ning*/ sde bdun/ gnam chos mdung 'dzin/ brag lha/ jo bo/ zhal bzhi/ nyang gi phyag bzhi/

stong nyid spros bral= gnod sbyin/ ma mo/ dud sol/ zhing 196) skyong*/ dur bdag snying thig ngan ne/ rta lha/ dzam la/ snying thig tshe ring ma/ gza'/ dur khrod= dam can/ rgyal ba shāka thub= drag sgrub/ tsi dmar/ thang lha/ spom ra/ snying thig g.yu sgron/ ngom rgyal/ klu rgyal bcas/ dus mchod rang rang gi gsol ka dmigs bsal rnams lhag por gtang*/ de min nam yin yang 'di ltar dus mchod 'don dgos lags// tshogs 'grigs/ bskang ba dri med shel phreng*/ bsdu na rang gzhung*/ tshogs bar bshags/ sgral stab/ drang lhag bcas/ dngos grub 'byung gter/ mngon rtogs nas/ spyan 'dren/ dmag gi tshogs dang gshegs su gsol: bar/ spyan 'dren/ ma hā ka la= sa ma ya hūm̐: bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ dbang skur sngags/ oṃ e= phyag 'tshal mgor/ rten brlab/ phyag 'tshal mthar/ bzhugs gsol gyi mthar phyag 'tshal sbyar/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ badz+ra yak+ṣa= mchod pa'i tshig mgor bdud rtsi mchod gsol/ hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po= 'grub par mdzod: mchod rab/ oṃ shrī ma hā ka la= phrin las mdzod cig: bskang rdzas byin rlabs/ bskang ba/ hūm̐: chos nyid rnam bdag= phyi 'khor gyi mgor bskang ba sbyar/ bskang bsdus/ bshags pa/ hūm̐: mgon po 'khor bcas= mnga' gsol/ mda' rab/ rnga rab/ dung rab/ rkang gling rab/ bsang*/ gsol mchod le tshan/ gsol bsdus/ sangs rgyas phrin las= grangs bsog tshar nyer lnga/ 197) yon 'bul/ shing rtsi/ mkhan bya/ shol tshig srung bkod/ srung 'dzug dpa' bkod/ dgra lha/ 'dod gsol/ 'brel drug bing gi rtse mo= bstod pa yan/ bdag gi thugs ka'i= gsol 'debs/ dzab dmigs/ gong non bsnyen pa/ gtso sngags brgya/ 'bod sngags sbrel ba nyer gcig yum sngags lnga bcu/ yab yum 'bod sngags sbrel bdun/ sngags 'grigs/ mchod pa'i sngags/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la= gong ltar/ phrin las mdzod cig: dpal ma hā kā la= bstod pa/ hūm̐: bskal pa= bshags pa/ smon lam bcas/ dam can gsol ring*/ dkar gtor/

rtsa brgyud= gur drag bskul/ byang shar pha mtha'/ chad brtan/ bro mnan/ lhan thabs ltar/ tshe 'gugs/ bkra shis/ nongs bshags/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ rgyun spyod/ rgyal dkyil bcas/ ༈ dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu la thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa'i tshogs skong gtong tshul ni/ hrīḥ sngon bskal= spos phyung*/ skyabs sems yan bdun/ maṇ+ḍal/ lam rim dang yid nor gang rung*/ dkar bgegs rnying sngon ltar/ las byang rin chen phreng ba'i bka' bsgo nas/ bstod bshags/ brgyud 'debs/ dzab bskul rgyas bsdus gang rung*/ hūm̐ sgrub/ mchod bstod dngos grub dge bsngo bcas/ gnam chos lus dkyil rnams/ ma mgon lcam dral/ skong ba nyer lnga/ legs ldan/ rat+na'i ma ning rgyas pa/ rten gtor/ bsnyen dmigs mchod bstod bcas/ gsol ka 198) tshar bdun/ dngos grub 'byung gter/ phyag bzhi/ stong nyid spros bral= gnam chos snying thig rata gling mkha' ri/ gsol ka cha tshang klu rgyal yan/ rig 'dzin byin 'bebs/ thugs sgrub las byang tshogs/ lha tshogs dgyes= bskang rdzas/ brgyud bskang ut+palam/ thugs sgrub bskang ba/ tshes bcu'i bskang ba/ gong du ma song na ma ning gsol ka dam bdar bskang ba bcas/ phyag bzhi/ gnod sbyin/ gza' sogs/ gong du las byang bton rigs kyi bskang ba/ dam can gsol ring bcas/ las byang tshogs mchod/ gtor bsngo rgyas bsdus gang rung gcig bskang thung*/ bar bshags/ tshogs 'gugs/ sgral stab/ drang lhag ༈ dkar gtor rtsa rgyud/ las byang bskul/ ma ning bskul/ chad mdo/ zor btegs rgyas bsdus gang rung gcig brtan ma/ bro mnan/ las byang gi tshe bum de nyid= bsnyen/ tshe 'gugs/ hūm̐: gsang ba bla med= bkra shis/ smon lam/ nongs bshags/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ hūm̐: snang stong zung 'jug= snyen sgrub mthar phyin= rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= bcas/ ༈ dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu bzhi/ hrīḥsngon= spos phyung*/ dpal chen 'dus pa'i gsol 'debs/ kun bzang yab yum=

skyabs sems/ yan bdun/ dkar bgegs snying thig ltar/ bgegs bskrad nas/ bstod pa/ snyen pa yan/ mchod bstod bcas/ gnam chos lus dkyil/ ma mgon/ skong ba nyer lnga/ legs ldan/ 199) rat+na'i ma ning*/ phyag bzhi/ stong nyid= sogs tshes brgyad ltar dang*/ mgon po tshogs kyi bdag po'i gsol mchod btang tshul kyang tshes brgyad ltar ro/ ༈ dkar phyogs kyi tshes bco lnga la tshe sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa'i gzhung bsrangs te bskang gso gtong tshul ni/ hrīḥ sngon bskal= spos phyung*/ he pa'i dmigs 'grigs ltar/ skyabs 'gro/ sems skyed/ maṇ+ḍal/ bgegs gtor dmigs 'grigs ltar/ las byang bka' bsgo mtshams bcad/ nang sgrub/ bh+rum̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa: med par bsgom: las byang byin 'bebs nas/ lha bskyed/ mdun bskyed nang sgrub/ tshig bdun/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag mchod/ khā hi= dmigs 'grigs bstod pa yongs rdzogs/ gsol 'debs/ las byang tshe bskul/ dmigs 'grigs dang las byang gab sprad mthar chags su btang*/ gnam chos gur drag bsam tan cho ga bka' brgyad/ dgongs 'dus/ kyai: nas/ bdag gyur cig: 'og gi stong pa'i ngang las= nyams dang ldan: 'og gi lus nang rtsa gsum= lhun gyi grub: mdun gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= phyag 'tshal bstaud: yab yum gtso bor= dngos grub thob: sngags ring thung gang 'dod/ las gsum dor/ king kang khro chu sogs nas seng gdong bar/ ma mgon lcam dral/ skong ba nyer lnga/ legs ldan/ ma ning*/ sde bdun 'khrugs bsal/ phyag bzhi/ dgongs 'dus bka' srung*/ gnod sbyin/ ma mo/ dud/ seng*/ dur/ ngan/ rta/ 200) rnam sras mdung dmar/ dzam la/ gza'/ spu gri mched gsum/ bsnyo kha/ tsi'u dmar/ mkha' ri/ thang lha/ spom ra/ g.yu/ ngom/ klu/ tshe sgrub byin 'bebs/ ༈ tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin phung ltar tshogs phud 'bul/ yaṃ bskang*/ bskang rdzas/ brgyud bskang*/ 'chi bdag bdud 'joms/ dgongs 'dus bskang ba/ sde bdun bskang ba/ rnam sras bskang ba/

spu gri mched gsum/ bsnyo kha bskang ba/ dam can gsol ring*/ rang gzhung*/ thog med dus nas= 'gugs sgral stab/ drang lhag dkar gtor/ rtsa brgyud/ las byang bskul/ ma ning bskul/ dgra chos/ chad mdo/ zor btegs rgyas bsdus gang rung gcig brtan ma/ bro mnan/ las byang gi tshe bum de nyid= bsnyen pa/ tshe 'gugs/ chos sku zhi ba= dgongs 'dus bskul/ las chas/ spu gri bskul/ bsnyo kha bskul/ sgrub lung*/ chad brtan/ bro mnan/ bkra shis/ nongs bshags/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ oṃ/ 'grub par gyur cig= rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= ༈ dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu bzhi/ bzhi la/ bstan pa skyong ba'i dam can chen po'i phrin las dngos grub rol mtsho gtong dgos pas/ hūm̐: o rgyan= sid+dhi hūṃ: kun bzang rdor sems= gdod nas rnam dag= bslab gsum rnam dag= brgyud 'debs/ khyab bdag ston pa= rang gi snying ga'i= rdo rje slob dpon= sems can bde dang= dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing= rang gzhung gi oṃ swa bhā wa= 'khor 'das kyi= snyen pa yab rkyang*/ brgya dang yum snyen nyer gcig sbrel ma bdun/ 201) hūm̐ ham̐'u hūm̐ḥ gis bsdu/ phaṭa phaṭaḥ kyis lhar ldang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta= nas gzhung gsal gtso dgu rdzogs nas/ ma gcig lha mo 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ bar/ rjes 'brang*/ zhing skyong nas/ bdud btsan klu gsum bar/ ma mgon/ skong ba/ nyer lnga/ legs ldan/ ma ning*/ phyag bzhi/ stong nyid spros bral= gnod sbyin/ ma mo/ dud/ seng*/ dur/ ngan/ rta/ dzam/ tshe/ gza'/ dam/ spu gṛ/ btsan/ thang*/ spom/ g.yu/ ngom/ klu bcas/ gter gzhi gnyis/ snyen dmigs/ he ru ka'i yig brgya gsum/ gong snyen badz+ra kro ta= brgya/ chos skyong so so'i snyen pa nyer gcig re/ sha sa na= gsum/ mchod bstod/ spro na bka' brgyad bde 'dus ltar/ tshogs bsgral bstab bcas/ gzhung gi skong ba/ bshags pa/ phrin bcol bcas/ tshogs btang yod na/ drang ba dang lhag ma/ gtor 'gugs nas bkra shis bar gyis legs par grub bo/

༈ dmar phyogs kyi tshes nyer bdun la 'jam dpal gshin rje la brten pa'i dgu gtor btang tshul ni/ hrīḥ sngon bskal= spos phyung*/ gnam chos sngon 'gro lta bu gtang*/ 'ja' tshon dkon mchog spyi 'dus/ zhi ba dang drag po/ bsam gtan cho ga bka' brgyad gang rung*/ dgongs 'dus/ tshe bdag rgyun khyer/ king kang dug ri/ bla med mgon la= tshar gcod mdzod: 'og gi sngags 'khor/ rang gi thugs kar= rtsa sngags yan/ gtor 'bul 202) 'khor sngags nas/ ma hā bha la= bar/ ya ma rā dza= srung dmigs bsnyen pa/ gong gi gtor 'bul bstod pa shwa lo ka khro chu/ 'char ka 'jigs byed/ rat+na'i rta nag stong pa'i ngang las= ye shes spyan drangs= 'og gi hūm̐: bde chen dbang drag= gshegs su gsol: gong gi bdag dang gtso bor= gyur: 'phror/ srid gsum ye= phyag 'tshal bstod: 'khor bstod med kyang chog 'khor sngags/ thugs ka'i 'od zer= rtsa sngags/ sngags tshan/ mchod bstod bya/ yang na mar 'gros kyi chog phyag rdor/ khyung*/ sangs gling phur pa/ phag mo/ nyang gi khros ma/ sgrol dkar/ ku ru kul le/ 'od zer can/ lo gyon/ mtsho rgyal/ 'ja' seng*/ ma mgon lcam dral/ skong ba nyer lnga/ ma ning*/ mdung 'dzin/ brag jo/ zhal/ bka' srung phyag bzhi'i mngon rtogs dang*/ las byang bstod pa/ mngon rtogs mtha'i sngags 'khor sngags bcas/ stong nyid spros bral= rat+na'i gnod sbyin/ ma mo dud sol/ bdud mgon seng gdong*/ dur bdag ngan ne/ rta lha/ dzam la/ tshe ring ma/ rat+na'i gza'/ dam can/ spu gri/ btsan/ thang*/ spom/ g.yu/ ngom/ klu bcas/ ༈ 'ja' tshon tshogs byin rlabs/ mchod pa/ yaṃ bskang*/ bskang rdzas/ dkon spyi'i bskang ba/ pha rol rgol 'joms bskang ba/ lcags ral bskang ba/ phyag bzhi'i gsol ka gnod sbyin bskang ba gnyer gtad/ zhing skyong bskang ba/ gza' bskang 203) 'dod gsol/ spyi bshags/ sgrol las spyi rgyug king kang zlog dmigs sngags tshan gnyis/ zlog thung*/ gnam phud/ drang lhag dkar gtor/ spro na dug ri'i nang gi

eḥgator snod= 'gugs pa sngags gsum re/ bsad sngags gsum/ 'og gi phyi rol gtam= sod gsum/ gong gi bstab pa yan/ bsdu na rtsa rgyud/ dkon spyi'i bskul/ dug ri/ hūm̐: 'jam dpal= ma lus 'grub par mdzod: phyag bzhi'i bskul/ gnod sbyin bskul/ zhing skyong bskul/ gza' bskul/ dgra chos rigs/ dkon spyi'i chad tho/ brtan ma/ king kang*/ gshin rje gshed po'i= bh+yo: zlog sngags brjod cing zor 'phen/ gtor ma dgra= bro 'gugs/ lo zla zhag dus= sgab mnan sngags/ rang nyid lhar gsal= nan: king kang*/ hūm̐: 'jam dpal= bcom ldan 'jam dpal go 'phang myur thob shog: rgyal dkyil 'khor=

bcas bya'o/ ༈ dmar phyogs kyi tshes nyer gsum la/ gur drag bka' brgyad yi dam gang rung btang*/ dpal ldan mgon po'i gsol mchod gtong dgos na tshes brgyad ltar ro/ ༈ dmar phyogs kyi tshes nyer lnga la rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying gi thig le'i yum ka bde chen rgyal mos gzhung bsrangs ste rtsa gsum skong gso gtong dgos pas/ byang sdom tshul bzhin blangs nas/ hūm̐: o rgyan= sid d+dhi hūm̐ḥ kun bzang rdor sems= spro na/ mkha' khyab ye shes= 204) mgon po srid zhi= bsdu na/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i= shes bya kun mkhyen= 'phags pa 'jig rten= phyi ltar rgyal ba'i= 'jam dpal byin rlabs= yon tan sangs rgyas= rig 'dzin brgyud 'debs/ skyabs sems nas/ bstod pa/ bzlas dmigs/ bsnyen pa gsum brgya/ gab byang dmigs pa/ bzlas pa brgya/ tshe sgrub/ hrī: snang srid= snyen pa brgya/ tshe 'gugs bcas/ yi dam dpal chen 'dus pa'am/ bla ma drag po rta khyung 'bar ba gang rung*/ bzlas pa'i bar/ mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo'i rgyud 'debs/ skyabs sems nas/ bzlas pa gsum brgya/ mchod phring*/ bstod pa/ yig brgya/ gnam chos lus dkyil rnams/ kun mkhyen pa'i gtor sngo/ ma mgon lcam dral/ bskang ba'i mthar 'khrugs skong*/ phud bshal/ mnga' gsol/ bstod pa/ phrin bcol bcas/ legs ldan/ ma ning*/ tshogs bdag mdung*/ brag jo/ zhal/ phyag stong nyid spros= gza' yi bskang gso khrag mtsho 'khyil pa/ phrin bcol bar/ gnod sbyin bskang gso dgra las rnam rgyal/ mnga' gsol bcas/ srog sgrub bskang gso ro langs thal byed/ phrin bcol bar/ dud gdon/ seng gdon/ dur bdag rnam sras/ dur khrod ma mo/ tshe ring ma/ mnga' gsol/ g.yang 'gugs phrin bcol bcas/ dam can/ drag sgrub/ g.yu sgron ma/ rgyal btsan/ gnod sbyin chen po'i dbang drag dus kyi pho nya mnga' gsol mthar/ mjug gi phrin bcol bcas/ thang lha/ spom ra/ ngom/ klu/ gser 205) skyems/ 'dod gsol/

sangs rgyas bstan pa= na rag bshags skong*/ smon lam bcas/ yum ka'i tshogs/ bshags pa mgor/ skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu'i/ na mo: bde gshegs= khaṃ swā hāḥ āḥ rang byung lhun grub= rdzogs pa chen po'i sa la skyolaḥ rig 'dzin skong ba/ yum bka'i skong ba/ tshogs bsdus/ tshogs rdzas 'dod yon= grangs gsog mdor na rab 'byams= yum ka'i/ ho/ ye shes= tshogs drang ba/ ho/ bla ma dpa' bo= bde bar gshegs pa= bdag lus phung khams= bsam lhun/ mtsho dbus= sogs/ tshogs la rol mthar/ he ru ka yi grong khyer du// tshogs kyi 'khor lo= sogs tshim pa drug ldan smon lam gdab/ tshogs glu/ e ma ki ri= btang*/ lhag ma/ a ka rā+o=/ lhag la dbang ba= na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud= sogs dam can spyi gtor ltar 'gugs pa/ gtor bsngo/ hūm̐/ rang byung lhun grub= bstod pa/ tshangs pa mgrin sngon= bshags pa/ ye shes las grub/ phrin bcol/ kun bzang zhi khro= thub pa'i bstan pa= sangs rgyas bstan srung = yum ka'i chad mdo/ brtan ma/ bro mnan/ rjes chog mchod pa las byang ltar/ bstod pa'i mgo mtha' sho lo ka gnyis/ dngos grub bskul/ nongs bshags/ rten bzhugs/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= bsdu ldang*/ bsngo ba/ smon lam/ bkra shis bcas so/ ༈ dmar phyogs kyi tshes nyer bzhi la mgon po tshogs bdag gi dgu gtor gtong dgos 206) pa tshes brgyad las 'grigs ltar/ stod las shin tu bsdus pa'i rigs btang nas/ bzlas pa/ sa sha tra ya thuṃ nan= bar gtang*/ rtsang gyer/ mdun du e nag po= a nṛ dzaḥ rang gi phar mdun= yod par bsam= hūṃ: sngon tshe dngos grub= baṃ hoḥ sprul pa'i pho nya= bsam= ska ུla pa glog zhags/ 'og cha spyan 'dren/ bdag nyid he ru ka'i= yang yang bstim/ gzu dpang chung ba/ hūm̐: bskal pa me ltar= gsang spur 'gugs/ gzhung 'gugs/ bden rtsa/ ka la ru pa= 'og gi gnad dbab/ bdag he ru ka= sngags bdun/ hūm̐ kha kha mu kha= las mdzod cig: oṃ sa na mu rbad: dgra bo 'di'i rgyab=

bstim/ bdag gi thugs ka nas= 'bod rbad cung zad/ rbad sngags mang bzlas/ sku gsung thugs/ gzhung ltar sngags bcas/ 'og gi bdag nyid yi dam= skul byang shar mthar/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā= 'bod rbad bsad sngags 'don/ mchod pa bstod pa rnams bya/ long skabs che dus/ go cha rab bdun dang*/ bswo cha bing gsum 'don/ min na las rbad tshar gcig bsad pa/ gru gsum nang du= las rbad bsdus pa/ mdun gyi ma hā ka la= sogs/ phaṭaḥ bswoḥ mgon po sku'i= dam nyams pa'i dgra bo= bsad/ bstan dgra gnod byed= bstab pa bya'o/ gtad khram/ g.yag ru/ byang shar pha mtha' grangs gsog dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ yi dam chad brtan sogs sngar ltar ro// ༈ dmar phyogs kyi tshes sum cu lnga la gnam chos thugs 207) kyi gter kha'i bskang gso gtong ba'itshul ni/ hrīḥ sngon bskal= spos phyung*/ gnam chos gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus/ skyabs 'gro lan gsum / ka dag= gats+tsha: zhing sgrub/ sman bla/ gnas chog snyen pa yan/ gong gi mchod pa/ phyag 'tshal gyis bstod/ 'og gi bshags pa/ oṃ:bdag ni= phyag mchod rgyas bsdus/ 'dod gsol/ skyabs gnas bslu ba= bkra shis/ nongs bshags/ tshe dpag 'don 'grigs gzhung ltar ram/ thob par shog= oṃ swa bha wa= lha la thim= lha spyi'i sgrub mchod/ bstod pa yan/ bsnyen dmigs mchod bstod bar/ lha spyi'i bshags pa/ tshe dpag rigs/ sgye'u las byang la bum tshig rigs dor/ gzhan thugs che chen po'i rigs/ rtsa ba bcu gnyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐: so so'i snyen pa cung zad byed/ kā ya wāka= sogs/ mtshan brgyad chig dril/ lha spyi'i sgrub mchod sbyar/ rtsa gsum las byang gsang sgrub sbyar/ bsam gtan cho ga bka' brgyad/ dgongs 'dus/ king kang*/ ro za/ rta phyag khyung gsum/ phur pa/ dme brtsegs/ phag khros/ sgrol dkar/ 'od zer can/ lo gyon/ mtsho rgyal/ gnam seng*/ ma mgon lcam dral/ skong ba nyer lnga/ gnam chos ma ning*/ mdung 'dzin/ brag mgon/ jo bo tshogs bdag zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pad nyi= gnam chos gnod sbyin/

gnam chos sngags srung lha mo'i las byang*/ dud sol/ zhing skyong*/ dur bdag ngan ne/ phyogs phyogs= dang*/ dur khrod mkha' 'gro= rta lha/ spyi gtor/ nor dbang*/ nor lha mo rigs/ tshe ring ma/ rang 208) snang 'od gsal= nor lha 'ga' zhig gza'/ dur khrod rab 'jigs= dang*/ gnam chos gza' dam gnyis/ bka' srung gsum/ btsan/ phyogs phyogs de ni= mgon dmar gsol mchod/ thang lha/ spom ra/ g.yu sgron/ ngom rgyal/ klu rgyal/ gnam chos byin 'bebs/ rno bkra tshogs rlabs nas/ khā hi: gtor bsngo bdud rtsi kun khyab/ 'grub par mdzod= bar/ bskang thung*/ bskang rdzas/ rdzogs bskang*/ rtsa tshig 'gres bshags/ ro za gsol ka bya bzhon bskang gsol/ 'dzam lha nyer gcig dam can mgar dmar/ 'dod gsol/ khyed cag= drang lhag bstod 'bum/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ thun gtor/ chad mdo/ brtan ma/ bh+yo: 'jig rten 'das dang= steng du bh+yo: zlog sngags brjod cing gtor ma 'phang*/ 'gugs bro/ bkra shis/ nongs bshags/ rten bzhugs/ snang srid ma lus= rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= ༈ gnyis pa rgyun du ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ tho rangs mal nas har gyis lang*/ rlung ro 'bud/ ngag byin gyis brlab/ kun slong bco/ bla rgyud gsol 'debs/ thun mong sngon 'gro gshar sgom/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ yig brgya nyer gcig 'od zhu/ maṇ+ḍal/ kus li'i tshogs gsog bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ gsol 'debs/ dbang bzhi blang*/ thugs yid bsre/ zangs mdog dpal ri'i smon lam gdab/ rnga brdungs nas yi dam dpal chen 'dus pa'i las 209) byang gtang*/ bzlas pa'i thun bcad/ nam langs nas thun grol/ stong tshig gi mchod bstod dang*/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon bkra shis bya/ chab gtor dang*/ dkar gsur gtang*/ rgyun bsang dang*/ dgra lha yul lha sogs 'don/ nyi ma dros nas snyen sgrub kyi thun la zhugs/ nyin phyed nas grol tshul sngar ltar/ rnga brdungs nas dngos grub 'byung gter tshar gcig gtang*/

gung tshigs dang*/ phyag dang dpe cha bri blta sogs byed/ nyi ma gug nas thun bsdam/ nyi ma zer bsdu dus grol nas/ rtsa gsum spyi gtor dang*/ bka' srung ma mgon lcam dral/ bskang ba tshar nyer lnga/ spro na 'khrugs skong*/ phud bshal/ mnga' gsol sogs kyang gtang*/ bstod pa/ phrin bcol/ legs ldan/ tshogs bdag/ gza'/ gnod sbyin/ srog sgrub/ ngan ne/ tshe ring*/ g.yu sgron/ tsi dmar/ spom ra/ gser skyems/ gter gzhi gnyis/ gtor bsngo/ bstod pa/ bshags pa/ phrin bcol/ gtor 'gugs nas bkra shis bar bya/ bsngo ba smon lam ji rigs/ dmar gsur btang nas thun la zhugs/ srod la grol nas/ lus sbyin dang*/ 'pho lung dmigs pa bya/ ldang ba'i 'du shes dang*/ snang mtha'i 'du shes kyi nyal/ tho rangs mal nas ldang ste sngar ltar byas pas don 'grub bo/ gsum pa rjes dran gyi mchod pa dus nam dgos pa dang*/ bya ba'i tshul lo/ dang po ni/ hor zla bcu gnyis ches bco brgyad kun mkhyen chos kyi 210) rgyal po'i dus mchod/ hor zla gcig tshes lnga la rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab 'das dus/ hor zla gnyis tshes gnyis la gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje'i 'das mchod/ tshes nyer gcig la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i dus dran/ tshes bcu gnam chos mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dus dran/ tshes nyer lnga o rgyan mdo sngags chos kyi nyi ma'i dus dran/ zla ba bzhi tshes nyer bzhi mkhas grub mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal dus dran/ zla lnga tshes nyer gsum karma 'gyur med nges don bstan 'dzin dus dran/ tshes nyer gcig pad+ma mdo sngags bstan 'dzin spobs pa mtha' yas dus dran/ zla bcu gcig tshes nyer bdun la 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas dus dran/ zla bcu gnyis tshes bco lnga la drin chen bla ma thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'od zer dus dran de rnams so/ gnyis pa ji ltar 'don pa'i tshul ni/ so so'i dus la bab pa'i tshe snga char bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho lta bu'i sgo nas tshogs skong bgyid dgos pa yin no//

slar smras pa/ rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' rgyud pa/ /shangs pa sbyor drug zhi byed snyen sgrub sogs// ris med gangs ljongs thub bstan ji snyed pa'i// bstan pa dar rgyas yun ring brtan gyur cig khyad par rgyal bstan phyi mo snga 'gyur ba// dbu phar 'dul mdzod bcu phrag 211)rig pa'i gnas// rgyud dang sgrub sde rim dgu theg pa'i chos// bshad dang sgrub pas 'dzam gling mdzes gyur cig /gang zhig dngos sam brgyud nas bstan dang 'gro'i// phan dang bde ba'i gzhir gyur dge ba'i bshes// phyag rgya rgya chen ngag gi dbang phyug che// dpal ldan skal bzang gnyen du bskal brgyar bzhugs// bdag kyang deng nas tshai rabs thams cad du// kun mkhyen bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing*// sras bcas rgyal ba'i rdzogs smin sbyang gsum kun// 'grub nas rnam mkhyen rgyal ba nyid gyur cig /phan bde'i dpal gyis phyogs dus yul kun khyab/ sgrib gnyis bag chags g.yul las rnam par rgyal// phyam cig gdod ma'i byang chub mngon gyur nas// gsang chen chos kyis 'dzam gling rgyan gyur cig ces pa'ang rgyal dbang dpal yul ba'i slob 'bangs thub bstan kun bzang 'jigs med bshad sgrub chos kyi glang por 'bod pas bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis// 212)
